statement: No attribute reference of a document resolves resource.attributes.<name> (a condition operand on either side, a rate limit key): nothing on the request path, in a check, or in the control plane's simulate and explain gives a resource attributes, so a DENY on one would deny nothing. The message says to put facts about a resource in its id and read them with a pattern variable. The policy test kit refuses a scenario that sets request.resource.attributes, for the same reason.
guards: model:ConditionCheckerTest#resource attributes are refused wherever they are referred to
testkit:StrictInputTest#a scenario that sets resource attributes is refused
